## Checklist

- [ ] The linked issue's acceptance criteria are met
- [ ] The repository's documented check command passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] User-facing documentation updated where behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, generated artifacts, or unrelated changes
- [ ] Breaking API, token, or schema changes are called out with migration notes
